component.name: Omafeed
component.summary: A quiet home for your feeds

description.p: Omafeed is a native RSS reader for Linux and Omarchy. A three-pane library, article list, and reading view keeps your subscriptions and articles on your computer.

ul.li: RSS, Atom, and JSON Feed with scheduled refresh while the app is open
Nested folders, OPML import and export, and full-text search
Sanitized, readable articles that work offline
Keyboard navigation and Omarchy theme following
